Simulate SCD data

Source: R/utils-scd-analysis.R
simulate_scd_data.Rd

Generates simulated single-case design data using a piecewise multilevel model.

Usage

simulate_scd_data(
  n_cases = 5,
  n_phase_a = 5,
  n_phase_b = 5,
  effect_size = 0,
  trend_effect = 0,
  autocorr = 0,
  baseline_mean = 50,
  baseline_sd = 10,
  baseline_trend = 0
)

Arguments

n_cases

Number of cases to simulate.

n_phase_a

Number of time points in phase A.

n_phase_b

Number of time points in phase B.

effect_size

Standardized effect size for the phase change.

trend_effect

Standardized trend effect after phase change.

autocorr

Lag-1 autocorrelation coefficient.

baseline_mean

Mean of the baseline phase.

baseline_sd

Standard deviation of the baseline phase.

baseline_trend

Linear trend in the baseline phase.

Value

A data frame with columns case, time, phase, phase_num, time_center, time_since_change, and outcome.

Examples

simulate_scd_data(n_cases = 3, n_phase_a = 5, n_phase_b = 5,
                  effect_size = 1.0)
